mcq_choices.choice_text: from lower to higher index only
mcq_choices.rationale: Reverses the required index relationship; total internal reflection needs light traveling from higher to lower index, not the other way around.

mcq_choices.choice_text: from higher to lower index above the critical angle
mcq_choices.rationale: TIR requires high-to-low index and sufficiently large incidence angle
States the opposite angular condition; total internal reflection requires an angle of incidence larger than, not smaller than, the critical angle.
Introduces an irrelevant medium requirement; total internal reflection depends on the index contrast between two media, not on vacuum specifically.

parts.prompt:
Total internal reflection can occur when light travels

A. from lower to higher index only
B. from higher to lower index above the critical angle
C. at normal incidence only
D. through a vacuum only

criteria.description: Select the single scientifically correct answer.
required_evidence: TIR requires high-to-low index and sufficiently large incidence angle

review_notes.expected_reasoning: TIR requires high-to-low index and sufficiently large incidence angle
